arguments.command:
find /app/submission -type f -exec ls -la {} \; && python3 -c "
import ast
src=open('/app/submission/main.py').read()
tree=ast.parse(src)
print('lines:', src.count(chr(10)))
print('top-level:', [n.name for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.ClassDef))])
print('imports:', sorted({n.names[0].name for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,(ast.Import,))} | {n.module for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom)}))
"
